release_candidate: v0.1.0-rc.2 (to be cut on this branch's final S3-10 commit; v0.1.0-rc.1 belongs to the divergent lineage and is left untouched)
status_summary: All Must ACs (AC1-AC9, AC11) and AC10/AC12 are implemented and tested on this branch. 'Met' means the capability exists and is covered by tests; final acceptance is the human Checkpoint-D gate, which an automated green build does not clear.

checkpoint_d.note: Checkpoint D (Final acceptance, guidance §11) is a human review gate. A green rehearsal and a passing CI run are NOT Checkpoint-D acceptance; review, merge and client sign-off remain open.

AC1.criterion: Reproducible NSW integrated dataset consumed by the app
evidence: DATA/integration/ frozen integrated table (input SHA df7073bd) served by pipeline.service
tests/integration/test_e2e_dataset_engine_app.py drives dataset -> engine -> app via FastAPI TestClient

AC2.criterion: Hard exclusions applied before scoring; reason retained
evidence: pipeline/exclusions/ with the seven frozen F16 reason codes; pipeline/exclusions/exclusion_rules.yaml
docs/release/rehearsal.json excluded_example (cell S28.186_E152.386, reason excessive_slope, null score/rank)

AC3.criterion: Every scoring feature documented (definition / unit / source / direction)
evidence: docs/technical-reference.md §5 and the formula header of pipeline/scoring/scoring_weights.yaml

AC4.criterion: Normalisation and scoring run outside the UI, covered by tests
evidence: pipeline/scoring/ (pure weighted MCDA); the web shell is asserted decision-free

AC5.criterion: Weights configurable; interpretation and defaults documented
evidence: app/web/app/shell/AnalysisControls.tsx (editable Baseline + locked Wind-led / Grid-led presets)

AC6.criterion: Component scores, total scores and deterministic rankings for eligible cells
evidence: pipeline/scoring/score.py and rank.py (ties break by ascending cell_id)
docs/release/rehearsal.json rank_1_detail (contributions reconcile to the score within 1e-9)

AC7.criterion: Understandable site-level explanations; demand proxy not misrepresented
evidence: pipeline/explanation/ (deterministic, no LLM); SiteDetailPanel demand-proxy caveat section
tests/backend/test_s309_docs_consistency.py (proxy framing + screening language guard, now covering docs/release/*.md)

AC8.criterion: Interactive NSW map plus ranked shortlist
evidence: CellMap (GET /runs/{run_id}/cells) and RankedShortlist (GET /runs/{run_id}/results); region fixed to NSW

AC9.criterion: At least two weighting scenarios / configurations compared
evidence: ScenarioComparison <- POST /scenario-comparison; Wind-led / Grid-led presets + Custom
docs/release/rehearsal.json scenario_comparison (23,261 of 23,266 cells moved between wind_led and grid_led)

AC10.criterion: Technical sanity checking against defensible reference locations
evidence: docs/release/rehearsal.json sanity (known-wind-farm quartile outcomes, contradiction_count=2, model-not-trained caveat present)

AC11.criterion: Clean install / run path and technical documentation
evidence: pipeline/README.md, app/README.md, docs/technical-reference.md; single commands python -m pipeline and docker compose up --build
docs/technical-reference.md §7 and screening banners across README / docs; CSV disclaimer line
